items.text: Know the room you are in and match the emphasis.
You do not need a formal title.
Adapt the details to your own life.
These are rated for how far your own effort can scale beyond a salary.
Leadership counts most when you carry responsibility for a result and a team.
Who pays you Customers and team members.

blocks.heading: Ownership a Team Needs People
rows: A team needs people who take responsibility
Say what you were responsible for and the result
Mention one thing you did for a teammate
Describe what you did when something failed
Share credit and own your part of mistakes
Say what you are still learning

blocks.heading: Weak Answers and Stronger Versions
rows: I organised a fair and here is what happened
I led a team of four and shared tasks
I am building it and here is a first example
A long story with many details
